prompt: Edit this existing Ship of Theseus isometric tactical-game tree sprite as a tightly controlled material revision, not a redesign. Keep the exact tree, branch arrangement, leaf-clump placement, rooted trunk, outer silhouette, atlas position and margins, canvas aspect ratio, scale and left-upper light direction. Preserve transparent background and fine alpha boundaries; do not add a background, halo, ground plane, objects or cast-shadow plate. This sprite is shown only about 60 pixels tall over dark mottled olive-brown ground. Its leaves currently disappear into that ground. Change ONLY foliage colour and tonal structure: lift dark and medium foliage tones to a readable restrained warm olive/sage green, compress existing leaf highlights so no white/yellow clipping or sparkling bright leaf tips occur, make foliage read as softly lit grouped volumes instead of salt-and-pepper noise. Retain shaded foliage on the lower/right undersides and dark gaps between clumps, keep detailed but subdued texture. Keep trunk, branches and roots their original dark muted brown, clearly distinct from leaves; do not brighten bark or add outlines everywhere. Aim for a modest foliage-to-ground luminance difference, not glowing bright green or saturated yellow. Do not introduce hard colour blocks. Output ONLY one revised standalone sprite in the original composition, transparent PNG. This is a production candidate to compare with the frozen original; exact geometry preservation is critical.
